observation.description: On packaged 0.1.7, any table carrying a v.assetRef field cannot be returned by ANY query: the result-contract compiler (@expo/snapback-codegen/result-contracts.mjs) maps String/Boolean/Integer/Real/Principal/RelationIncarnation/Id/Json and throws 'unsupported result validator' for AssetRef, so both defineLiveQuery({table:'records'}) and defineJsLiveQuery(results.documents('records')) refuse at generation with SNAPBACK_HANDLER_RESULT_CONTRACT_INVALID ({"AssetRef":{}} and the restricted form alike). The guide's assets page teaches v.assetRef attachment on ordinary tables; the obvious next step — querying that table — is inexpressible. Workaround used by this arm: move the typed reference to a side table no query returns and carry a plain-string asset id on the queryable row.

competitorOutcome.description: Frozen Firebase/Supabase evidence stores file references as ordinary row fields (storage path strings/URLs) that flow through every query; no frozen competitor separates reference typing from queryability.

mustNotRegress: The commit-boundary verification itself (raw id-shaped strings into assetRef fields must keep failing closed).
smallestCoherentFix: Add an AssetRef mapping to the result-contract compiler (id-shaped scalar with asset provenance), with a packaged-closure conformance test that live-queries a table carrying an assetRef field.
acceptanceWitness: A fresh external scaffold declares v.assetRef on a synced table and both a declarative and a JS live query over that table pass codegen and return rows on the public closure.
